vitamin_d.label: Vitamin D
vitamin_d.what: UVB on uncovered skin starts vitamin D production. The estimate is rough, and more sun is not always better.

pomc.label: Skin & mood
pomc.what: Sunlight on skin can start signals involved in pigment, stress response, and how sunlight feels.

no_cv.label: Blood vessels
no_cv.what: UVA can release nitric oxide stored in skin, which may temporarily relax blood vessels.

violet_eye.label: Outdoor eye light
violet_eye.what: Outdoor light includes violet wavelengths that are reduced by many windows. Their human effects are still being studied.

circadian.label: Body clock
circadian.what: Outdoor light reaching your eyes helps your body know when it is day. Timing matters more than a score.

nir_solar.label: Cell energy & repair
nir_solar.what: May support cell energy and repair signals. This is modeled from red and near-infrared light, and the research is still developing.

pbm_red.label: Red light device
pbm_red.what: A device delivers a targeted red-light signal. It is tracked separately from sunlight.

pbm_nir.label: Near-IR device
pbm_nir.what: A device delivers a targeted near-infrared signal. It is tracked separately from sunlight.

styleBlocks.declarations: display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-secondary) 78%, transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 82%, transparent);font-size:12px;color:var(--text-secondary);transition:background 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 42%, transparent);border-style:dashed;border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-muted) 48%, var(--border));color:var(--text-muted);

margin-top:0;padding:18px 20px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 82%, transparent);border-radius:var(--radius);background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-card) 94%, transparent);box-shadow:var(--shadow);

grid-area:icon;width:34px;height:34px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:50%;font-size:18px;background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--channel-accent) 13%, var(--bg-card));border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--channel-accent) 30%, transparent);

grid-area:count;min-width:0;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--channel-accent) 12%, transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--channel-accent) 26%, transparent);color:var(--text-primary);text-align:center;

background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-secondary) 38%, transparent);border-style:solid;border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 88%, transparent);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-muted) 28%, transparent);color:var(--text-muted);
background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-card) 70%, transparent);border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 78%, transparent);opacity:0.72;

border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--channel-accent) 62%, var(--border));box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--channel-accent) 86%, transparent),
    0 8px 18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--channel-accent) 12%, transparent);

border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--channel-accent) 64%, var(--border));box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--channel-accent) 90%, transparent),
    0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--channel-accent) 42%, transparent);
